headline: Ansar Allah ballistic missile toward Riyadh intercepted overnight
dek: (a) Coalition air defences intercepted and destroyed a Ansar Allah ballistic missile toward Riyadh — VERIFIED FACT of coalition announcement (attribution is the coalition's). (b) Saudi Civil Defence issued emergency warnings in Riyadh and Najran, then declared the danger passed — VERIFIED FACT of posts.
sources: Saudi-led coalition spokesperson Turki al-Maliki (X via CJFCSpox); Saudi Civil Defence (@SaudiDCD)
fault_line: Did Saudi air defenses really stop the Ansar Allah missile over Riyadh — or did the strike get through and is the capital now exposed?

sections.what_happened: (a) Coalition air defences intercepted and destroyed a Ansar Allah ballistic missile toward Riyadh — VERIFIED FACT of coalition announcement (attribution is the coalition's). (b) Saudi Civil Defence issued emergency warnings in Riyadh and Najran, then declared the danger passed — VERIFIED FACT of posts. (c) No Ansar Allah claim of the launch visible in available reporting at scan time — the group's attribution of this specific missile is UNVERIFIED.
sections.what_verified: Al Jazeera liveblog (direct AJ site, entries 01:14/01:37/01:45 GMT Oct 23). Consistent with Ansar Allah maritime-embargo posture recorded at totw-20261023-0200-04.
sections.what_disputed: Interception success is the coalition's claim only; no independent damage/impact assessment; no Ansar Allah responsibility claim confirmed at scan time — attribution of the missile to the Ansar Allah rests on the coalition statement.
sections.why_matters: Riyadh in the crosshairs: a ballistic missile at the Saudi capital and what it says about the Ansar Allah escalation
sections.context: Background: NEW — Ansar Allah ballistic missile toward Riyadh intercepted overnight; Saudi Civil Defence issued then lifted emergency alerts in Riyadh and Najran (AJ liveblog 01:14–01:45 GMT = 05:14–05:45 )

totw_analysis: Our read: Riyadh in the crosshairs: a ballistic missile at the Saudi capital and what it says about the Ansar Allah escalation The fault line our audience is arguing over: Did Saudi air defenses really stop the Ansar Allah missile over Riyadh — or did the strike get through and is the capital now exposed?
